subject: Recap & next steps: SOC 2 scope, logs, retention, and DPA (LedgerPay / Redwood)
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@ledgerpay.com>, security@ledgerpay.com
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & next steps: SOC 2 scope, logs, retention, and DPA (LedgerPay / Redwood)

Hi Elaine / LedgerPay security team —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Short summary and concrete next steps so we have shared expectations: 

Summary of pain points you shared:
- Upcoming third-party audit this Q3 and need evidence for vendor controls (SOC 2 Type II preferred).
- Requirement to retain audit logs for up to 7 years for specific payment events.
- KMS/HSM integration and customer-managed keys for high-sensitivity flows.
- DPA terms around deletion timelines, subprocessor list, and incident notification SLA.
- Desire for a private deployment (VPC) with strict network isolation for card-related workloads.

Goals from your side:
1) Get a clear template of artifacts Redwood can provide (SOC2 report, pen test summary, sample audit logs).
2) Surface options for log retention and export (native retention vs. S3 archive).
3) Agree on DPA redlines or a path to sign a DPA within procurement timelines.
4) Schedule a technical deep-dive on KMS and VPC/network config if needed.

Concrete next steps (action owners & rough timing):
- Redwood: Share SOC2 stub and high-level pen-test summary by EOD Thu (rachel.kim@redwood.com) — attachment + Drive link.
- LedgerPay: Confirm procurement contact and target DPA sign date (Elaine / Jeremy) — by Wed next week.
- Redwood infra (cc Karthik): Prepare sample anonymized audit log extract and retention export options (by end of next week).
- Neha (cc): Pull a summary of current encryption/KMS options and customer-managed key support.

Questions we flagged that need quick answers from LedgerPay:
1) Are all 7 years required for all event types, or only payment reconciliation events?
2) Any mandatory formats for exported logs (syslog/JSON/CSV)?
3) Any internal reviewers for a DPA redline?

Attachments: meeting-ics.

If that matches your understanding, I’ll drop the SOC2 stub + pen-test summary into the Drive link below and send a DPA draft for redline. We can also block 60 minutes next Wed for the technical deep-dive — proposed 10:00 PT.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference

From: Elaine Park <elaine@ledgerpay.com>

Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps: SOC 2 scope, logs, retention, and DPA (LedgerPay / Redwood)

Thanks Rachel — that recap is spot on. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

Answers to your questions:
1) Retention: The 7-year requirement applies to settlement and reconciliation events only. Operational logs can be retained for 2 years.
2) Format: JSON with one event per line is preferred for our archive pipeline; CSV is acceptable for smaller exports.
3) DPA reviewers: Legal will be Jeremy (cc'd). For security technical review, our infosec alias security@ledgerpay.com will be primary.

Timeline:
- Procurement: We aim to have a signed DPA within 6 weeks; I’ll introduce Jeremy to your procurement contact this week.
- Audit artifacts: SOC 2 Type II report is preferred; if Redwood can provide a formal report we can log it for our vendor risk. Pen-test summary is required (high level ok).

I attached our vendor questionnaire (redacted) and the internal retention policy excerpt so you can align the sample logs.

Happy to take the 10:00 PT slot next Wed if that works for your infra team.

Best,
Elaine
Elaine Park
Head of Vendor Risk, LedgerPay
elaine@ledgerpay.com

Attachments: ledgerpay_vendor_questionnaire.pdf, ledgerpay_retention_excerpt.pdf
